purpose: Guide a synthetic on-call operator through a safe queue backlog response with checks, escalation, and recovery evidence.

facts.text: Definition: This runbook applies only to the synthetic Ember Mail queue in the isolated exercise environment.
Definition: The queue warning threshold is more than 200 pending test messages for five continuous minutes.
Definition: The queue critical threshold is more than 500 pending test messages for ten continuous minutes.
Definition: The synthetic dashboard shows pending count, oldest message age, worker count, and delivery error rate.
Definition: The operator must record the observation time and all four dashboard measures before changing a worker setting.
Definition: The exercise allows the operator to restart one stalled worker after confirming its lease is expired.
Definition: The operator must not restart a worker with an active lease because duplicate delivery is possible.
Definition: The operator may raise worker count from two to four only when the pending count is above warning threshold and error rate is below one percent.
Definition: The operator must not raise worker count above four without the exercise controller approval.
Definition: After an allowed change, the operator checks all four measures every five minutes for 20 minutes.
Definition: Recovery requires pending count below 50, oldest message age below five minutes, and error rate below one percent for two consecutive checks.
Definition: If the critical threshold is crossed or errors reach one percent, the operator pauses changes and contacts the exercise controller.
Definition: If a delivery result is uncertain, the operator preserves message IDs and does not resend blindly.
Definition: The exercise controller, not the operator, decides whether to replay uncertain messages.
Definition: The synthetic audit note records initial measures, action, authorization if any, each follow-up check, and unresolved message IDs.
Definition: The runbook has no authority to affect production queues or real accounts.
A simulated trial on 2026-03-03 cleared a backlog of 260 test messages after scaling from two to four workers.
The trial does not prove the same action will resolve a backlog caused by delivery errors.

required_goals.statement: Preserve the exact scenario facts and their observed, proposed, assumed, or defined status.
required_goals.acceptance: Every factual assertion agrees with a relevant supplied fact; no changed actor, number, date, or status.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer compares claims with the fixed fact ledger.

required_goals.statement: Cover all required facts and section purposes.
required_goals.acceptance: Each required fact appears accurately in an appropriate section and each section fulfills its instruction.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer checks required fact IDs and section instructions against the output.

required_goals.statement: An operator can decide when to act, stop, escalate, and declare synthetic recovery using explicit criteria.
required_goals.acceptance: The document supports its stated reader decision or action within its declared scope.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer assesses the fixed purpose and audience against the output.

required_goals.statement: Do not add unsupported facts, outcomes, causal conclusions, or authority.
required_goals.acceptance: No material claim exceeds the supplied facts, including headings, lists, tables, and captions.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer audits all factual text and planted negative assertions.

required_goals.statement: Keep observed results, proposed actions, assumptions, definitions, and unknowns distinct.
required_goals.acceptance: The output never presents a proposal as enacted, an assumption as observed, or an unresolved matter as settled.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer classifies material assertions against source status and explicit unknowns.

negative_cases.mutated_assertion: The trial proves scaling fixes delivery-error backlogs.
The critical threshold is 50 pending messages for ten minutes.
The operator decides to replay uncertain messages.
A growing queue is always caused by too few workers.
Restart a worker even when its lease is active.
- Recovery is complete after one check below 50 pending messages.
Operators may scale above four workers without approval.

length_goal.reason: Operators need accurate actions, prerequisites and stopping rules; the suggested length is guidance and cannot replace independent operational review.
